content:
We created the Github issue for Encrypt The Mempool #9 and scheduled it for Wednesday, August 19 at 15:00 UTC.
(Justin F is on holiday this week.)

We'll continue the discussion from last week, including:

- Enshrinement: Are we OK with a non-PQ temporary solution?
- Validator Whitelist: How do we prove 1) withholding, 2) key selling? Can these proofs be automated?
- Achieving CR for the original EIP-8105 trusted set: https://notes.ethereum.org/@anderselowsson/CR-in-EM-with-trusted-set

Feel free to add other items to the agenda.
https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2193

See you all then!
